title: More Binary Risks In A World Of Binary Choices
text:
More Binary Risks In A World Of Binary Choices

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 4 Nov 2026

A fascinating American tradition is the disparity between the various districts in reporting electoral results. Unfortunately, this inability to deliver clear-cut results before people head off to bed can prove to be a source of tension and disappointment, since voters sometimes fall asleep believing in one outcome, only to wake up to its polar opposite the next morning. In turn, this opens the door to challenges, partisan rhetoric etc.In this election cycle, however, the fear of contested elections should not be too much of an issue. As the lack of GOP signs, Trump bumper stickers, and red hats—even in the conservative parts of America—augured, the Republican Party took a beating in Tuesday’s midterms. It seems Donald Trump’s war to achieve regime change in Iran has ended up triggering regime change across the US.
